action_items: In /app/backend/little_legacy_production.py, ensure the mastering pipeline ALWAYS persists color_palette (from character bible palette) and canon_notes (canon-lock notes) on the master document, including when triggered by a live regenerate. critical_code_review_comments: LittleLegacyStudio.js is ~580 lines with three large in-file components (MasteringTab, PilotTab, PublishingPackage). Still under 700 but consider extracting into /app/frontend/src/pages/little-legacy/ modules.

PublishingPackage panel expects pkg.brand_verification_checklist items to have {item, ok} shape and renders a green Check icon when ok else an amber ShieldCheck — good defensive rendering; both fallback icons render even when a field is missing.
In PilotTab the target of 'Open in YouTube Publisher™' is a plain <a href='/youtube'> anchor. This causes a full-page navigation; consider react-router Link for SPA nav consistency (non-blocking).
MasteringTab.startMaster still optimistically writes status=RENDERING without rollback on POST error — flagged in iter65, still present, low priority.

Both PilotTab poll (6s) and MasteringTab poll (5s) continue running while other Tabs are focused because Radix TabsContent keeps children mounted. Not a correctness bug (intervals are cleaned on unmount) but wasteful. Consider gating on active tab.

The Publishing Package brand checklist items in the UI are keyed by c.item — if two items share the same text this would collide (React key warning). Backend currently produces 7 unique items so this is safe, but keying by index would be defensive.
